title: Hornbill nest lockdown skit
storyboard: Film: one actor plays both hornbills: behind a cardboard 'mud wall' with a slit, then passing fruit in

scenes.headline: Me: sealing myself inside a tree for nesting season
Him: 'Fruit delivery. Through the slit. Again.'
Hornbills nest walled in, fed through a tiny gap
scenes.body: The nest hole is closed with mud except a small opening the male passes food through. Only the two ground hornbills skip it.

caption:
Nesting season, but make it a lockdown.

After the eggs hatch, the female breaks out of the nest, and the chicks may be walled in again. Indian grey hornbills and Oriental pied hornbills (in the clip) both nest in tree cavities like this.

Source: Britannica (Hornbill).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Classic one-actor, two-character skit (cardboard 'mud wall' prop) built around a true and surprising nesting fact; fruiting-tree clip shows the delivery menu.
